scope: Synthetic validation only. No observed optical posterior or observed NIR outcome is authorized by this executor.
ordering: object first, then truth case, then noise seed; all 12 cases retained, no replacement
random_streams: NumPy default_rng(SeedSequence([noise_seed, object_index, truth_index, role_index])); role 0 optical, role 1 NIR. Residual SED default_rng(epsilon_seed).normal(size=(2,42))[object_index].
measurement: Fixed diagonal quoted errors, signed Gaussian noise without cuts. Latent M20 residual SED already included; no additional model-error covariance.
calibration: Original release passbands and standards; fixed nominal zero points. No fitted correction or recalibration.
model: Pinned M20 W0/W1/L_Sigma; theta N(0,1), epsilon_white42 N(0,I), AV Exp(scale .329), RV U(1.2,6), tau U(-10,20).

distance.broad: D=mu+gray, mu Uniform(20,50), gray Normal(0,.088^2); exact normalized convolution density

algorithm_equivalence: Sample D as an explicit latent instead of numerically marginalizing it in NUTS. This has the identical proper joint density; independent scalar-D quadrature and sampling/predictive-ratio checks are required. No profiled amplitude or improper distance prior.

sampler.initial_other: D=mu_LCDM, AV=.2, RV=3.1, theta=0, epsilon_white=0; no held-out-dependent initialization

timing_boundary: Pr(tau within 1 rest day of either boundary)>0.01 is timing-limited, retained without expansion or deletion.
broad_boundary: Compute conditional mu|D under the convolved uniform prior; posterior probability within 1 mag of either mu bound must be below .001 or report prior-boundary sensitivity.
predictive: Joint NIR-vector density averaged over the complete optical posterior. The same D/tau/dust/shape/SED draw predicts all epochs and bands. Independent arm seeds; chain and contiguous-block MC errors retained. No observed outcomes.
isolation: Workers receive an optical-only synthetic payload. Their file-read guard rejects synthetic NIR payloads and all real photometry/sealed payload files. Optical records and diagnostics are hash-frozen before synthetic scoring.

resources.policy: Never shorten chains and call them validated. First run one declared case only; reassess the full 12-case schedule against the original one-hour two-CPU screen cap.
resources.wall_enforcement: Internal check is between complete chains, not in-flight. The documented launch uses GNU timeout with a 3600-second process-group limit and 30-second termination grace; preserve partial chains and do not label an interrupted run converged.

interpretation: An implementation and model-conditional power screen, not calibrated frequentist coverage, a population Bayes factor, or an age correction. AV=0 does not identify RV. An injected grey offset need not be recovered as a changed external cosmological distance.
